title: Console routes missing for links: checklist anchor, concept page on fresh load of /concepts/<id>, drawer for unloaded/renamed boards
description: Found while writing docs/console-links.md. (1) The story checklist is a panel in the board drawer with no hash or query of its own. (2) /newsroom/concepts/<id> shows the concept index on a first load because parseRouteSelection reads the segment as a category; only ?node= works. (3) ?open=contentItem:<lineage> is silent when the story's column is not loaded (published/spiked load when opened), and the /articles to renamed-board redirect drops the query. Also: publish the board path segment so the CLI can link renamed boards.
